description.en: Effective control of the Syrian interior around Damascus; claimed area (Palestine, Lebanon, Transjordan) far larger and not controlled.
description.ar: سيطرة فعلية على الداخل السوري حول دمشق؛ أما المنطقة المطالب بها (فلسطين ولبنان وشرق الأردن) فكانت أوسع بكثير ولم تكن خاضعة لسيطرته.
description.he: שליטה אפקטיבית בפנים סוריה סביב דמשק; השטח שנתבע (פלשתינה, לבנון ועבר הירדן) היה גדול בהרבה ולא היה בשליטה.

sources.quote: elected Faisal I ... king of a united Syria (including Palestine)
On the 8th of March, the General Syrian Congress sat in Damascus and passed a resolution proclaiming the independence of Syria (including Palestine and the Lebanon) as a sovereign state

sources.locator: section 'War's Aftermath: Faisal's Rule and the Resurgence of the Local Order'
sources.quote: Proclaimed king by the Syrian Congress in March 1920, he was forced to abandon his capital four months later as the French army of the Levant under General Gouraud advanced upon it from Beirut.
French columns advanced on Damascus and entered the city on the tenth day following its presentation.
The Syrian declaration of independence in Damascus, in the congress of 7 March 1920, recognized the right of the Lebanese to preserve their own form of administration

notes.en: Golan inclusion schematic, as for the preceding Arab administration.
notes.ar: إدراج الجولان تخطيطي، كما في الإدارة العربية السابقة.
notes.he: הכללת הגולן סכמטית, כמו במנהל הערבי הקודם.
